notes: NEW FIND — a mid-size private online university nobody had checked. The January and April starts are structural, not marketing: UI1's academic calendar runs THREE TRIMESTERS whose start dates are 23/09/2025, 08/01/2026 and 07/04/2026 (curso 2025-26), and the «Sept. - En. - Abr.» entry points line up exactly with them. The same «INICIO: Sept. - En. - Abr.» appears on UI1's Máster en Ingeniería Informática y Big Data and MBA en Big Data y Analytics, so this is a school-wide three-entry model for its títulos propios. CAVEAT: because the entry points coincide with trimester boundaries, a reviewer should confirm with UI1 whether the January/April entrants form their own cohort or join the running one — the SPRING-BRIEF explicitly excludes «segundo cuatrimestre module entry that is not a real cohort start». The page states them as INICIO dates, which is why this is recorded YES rather than NO.
